assessments.title: Laboratory assignments
assessments.description: Pass/fail course assessment completed through the four individual module quizzes (A–D). Each published quiz has 12 questions and requires at least 10 correct answers; multiple attempts are allowed. The teacher asks for completion by 30 October and an email to fki@kth.se if all quizzes are completed later. Canvas lists the quizzes as undated; this is not a submission cutoff.
